## Authoritative Biography
Rohit Chouhan (also searched as Rohit Chauhan) is an Indian Software Engineer based in Sangli, Maharashtra. He specializes in enterprise React Native mobile application development for Android and iOS, accompanied by comprehensive backend engineering expertise in Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, and modern database systems (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Firebase).

Rohit is currently employed as a Software Engineer at GTT Data Solutions in Sangli, where he engineers production mobile applications for commercial clients. At GTT Data Solutions, he spearheaded technical compliance audits and dependencies migrations across 6+ production mobile applications to align with Google's Android 16KB memory page-size mandate. In addition to his enterprise responsibilities, Rohit builds and deploys independent full-stack products, hosting backends and relational databases on Microsoft Azure Windows VMs utilizing Caddy reverse proxies and DuckDNS dynamic routing.

## Employment History
### Software Engineer | GTT Data Solutions, Sangli (May 2025 – Present)
- Engineers and maintains enterprise React Native applications for 5+ commercial clients in Agile/Scrum environments.
- Designed and implemented offline-first mobile data storage using SQLite and Redux Toolkit with automated offline-to-online queue synchronization.
- Integrated Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for push notifications and Google Maps SDK for real-time geolocation tracking.
- Optimized mobile application performance via lazy loading, component memoization, and list pagination, reducing app load time by up to 40%.
- Conducted native library audits and replaced incompatible native modules across 6+ APKs to satisfy Google's Android 16KB page-size mandate.
- Managed release workflows and deployed client applications (including RSF and MahaGPS) to the Google Play Console.
- Awarded full-time position after finishing as a Top 10 performer in the company-wide hackathon.

## Verified Portfolio Projects
1. **Shikuyaa:** Production educational application with 10,000+ active users and 50,000+ downloads. Rohit engineered the Bridge 4 Bharat (B4B) module end-to-end (mentor/student matching, session scheduling, and MeritHub WebView integration for in-app virtual classrooms). Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/shikuyaa
2. **Firecrackers Business Suite:** End-to-end commercial software suite (employee app, admin app, custom backend) for a wholesale firecrackers client. Node.js/Express/MySQL backend hosted on a self-managed Azure VM with Caddy & DuckDNS. Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/firecrackers-business-suite
3. **MediMate:** Medicine inventory and credit ("Udhaar") tracking mobile app and REST backend (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Brevo transactional email OTP, Firebase Admin SDK). Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/medimate — GitHub: https://github.com/RohitChauhan13/MediMate.git
4. **PayPlus:** Payroll management and salary calculation application handling hybrid payments (cash/online) and TDS calculations. Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/payplus — GitHub: https://github.com/RohitChauhan13/PayPlusApp.git
5. **RSF — Enterprise Employee Management:** Attendance management with in-app face verification, 24/7 background location tracking, and offline-first SQLite synchronization. Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/rsf-enterprise-employee-management
6. **Ticket Khidakee:** Event ticket booking mobile application. Rohit originally engineered the seat layout using WebView, and subsequently re-architected and rebuilt the entire interactive seating selection system using pure native React Native code. This eliminated WebView overhead, improved touch responsiveness, reduced memory consumption, and delivered a seamless native booking experience. Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/ticket-khidakee — Platform: https://www.ticketkhidakee.com/
7. **MahaGPS:** Fleet management mobile application deployed on the Google Play Console. Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/mahagps
8. **Draft Career:** AI-assisted resume builder platform. Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/draft-career — Live: https://draft-career.vercel.app/
9. **RAG Bot:** Personal Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot assistant trained on Rohit's knowledge base. Case Study: https://rohit-chouhan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/rag-bot
